content.title: How to watch, listen to Houston Cougars’ second-round NCAA tournament game vs. Texas A&M
content.text: HOUSTON (CW39) — The University of Houston men’s basketball team continues NCAA Tournament play against in-state rival Texas A&M on Saturday night in Oklahoma City. The winner advances to the South Regionals and the Sweet 16, which is going to be held at Toyota Center in Houston next week. The Cougars (29-6) are the No. 2 seed in the South Region after a dominant season that kept them in the top 10 in both major polls for the entire season. Houston beat Idaho 78-47 in the first round of the tournament, while Texas A&M beat Saint Mary’s 63-50. Kingston Flemings is averaging 16.4 points, 5.3 assists and 1.6 steals for the Cougars. Emanuel Sharp is averaging 12.3 points and 2.7 rebounds while shooting 34.1% over the last 10 games. Texas A&M (22-11) is led by Rashun Agee, who is scoring 14.9 points per game and averaging 8.9 rebounds for the Aggies. Rylan Griffen is averaging 2.1 3-pointers over the last 10 games. Houston owns a 55-32 lead against Texas A&M in the series, which began during the 1950-51 season. How to watch The game is scheduled to tip off at 5:10 p.m. Saturday and will air on TNT. Brandon Gaudin (play-by-play), Chris Webber (analyst) and Andy Katz (reporter) will be on the call. The game will also be streamed on HBO Max and the NCAA’s March Madness Live app. How to listen The University of Houston radio broadcast will be on 950 AM KPRC and the Varsity Network app with Jeremy Branham (play-by-play) and Elvin Hayes (analyst). The pregame show begins at 4:55 p.m. Saturday. The game will also be on Westwood One/NCAA Radio with Ted Emrich (play-by-play) and Casey Jacobsen (analyst). Where to watch In Houston, there will be a watch party at Avenida Plaza in front of the George R. Brown Convention Center starting at 3:40 p.m. Saturday. Fans can watch the game on a massive 20-foot LED screen, and multiple 80-inch monitors will be placed throughout the plaza. Food and beverages will be available for purchase, and restaurants on Avenida will be open for dining. A DJ will keep the energy flowing with music throughout the evening, and fans can play games, take pictures at selfie stations and compete in games and challenges for a chance at winning free prizes. The UH Team shop will be set up for fans wanting to purchase Cougar gear.
